subject: Columbus School Renaming Presentation
overview: The committee finalized and unanimously approved its presentation slide deck on the three school renaming finalists for the School Committee. It also selected members to deliver the presentation, censured a committee member, and received student voting results from the Columbus School.

items.title: School Committee Presentation Logistics Resolution
items.summary: Tabled a resolution regarding School Committee presentation logistics and speaker selection in order to take up a proposed deliberation time limit.

items.title: Deliberation Time Limit Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution, as amended to a 6:00 PM cutoff, to conclude deliberations on the slide deck during the meeting.

items.title: Motion to Approve Presentation Slides As-Is
items.summary: Tabled a motion to immediately adopt the slide deck as submitted to allow members to continue line-by-line review.

items.title: Review of Missituk and Jean Barry Sutherland Slides
items.summary: Reviewed and modified wording across the Missituk and Jean Barry Sutherland slides, defeating a motion to remove bullet points characterizing Sutherland's community impact.

items.title: Motion to Censure Committee Member
items.summary: Approved a motion to censure Melissa Miguel following comments questioning the historical existence of Belinda Sutton.

items.title: Review of Belinda Sutton Slides and Recommendations Slide
items.summary: Amended the Belinda Sutton slides to cite her petition for a pension and historical interpretations regarding reparations, while deleting a separate slide containing recommendations deemed beyond the committee's scope.

items.title: Approval of Final Presentation Slides
items.summary: Approved unanimously the presentation slide deck subject to non-substantive formatting cleanups and script summaries.

items.title: Selection of School Committee Presenters
items.summary: Approved the untabled logistics resolution and confirmed volunteers to present the committee's process, rubric, and finalist names to the School Committee.

items.title: Report on Columbus School Student Voting
items.summary: Kathleen Kay presented the results of the student vote among the three candidate names conducted at the Columbus School.
